title: Story Project Core & Manuscript Structure
selected_by_owner: 2026-10-04 owner explicitly approved the CWKS-06 written Story Project Core specification, approved the next implementation step, and directed work through implementation. AI writing/generation remains explicitly excluded.
objective: Implement the approved non-AI Story Project core over the published CWKS document engine: flexible arbitrary-depth manuscript structure, stable story-node/document references, deterministic structural operations and manuscript projection, provider-neutral local persistence/autosave/recovery, and an accessible reusable workspace over CreatorDocumentEditor.

include: dependency-free CreatorStoryProjectV1 schema, validator and stable story-node contract
arbitrary-depth flexible manuscript tree without mandatory Series → Book → Part → Chapter → Scene hierarchy
deterministic insert/remove/move/reorder, parent/ancestor/descendant helpers and manuscript/document projections
optional documentId association without embedding or cloning CreatorDocumentV1 content
provider-neutral Story Project local-store persistence, autosave/recovery and stale-write conflict protection
accessible reusable React Story Project workspace composing the existing CreatorDocumentEditor
keyboard/touch structural controls, selected-document loading and Previous/Next manuscript navigation
focused CWKS-06 tests, sealed CWKS regressions and governed Linux/Windows deterministic validation
exclude: AI writing, generation, critique, rewriting, summarization or AI knowledge assistance
wiki pages, aliases, backlinks, [[links]], transclusion or knowledge graph
Story Bible or CreativeFragment lifecycle/provenance authority
Plot/Adventure semantic graph or D28 Adventure truth
visual corkboard, storyboard, timeline or plot-board UI
collaborative editing, comments or named version-history UI
GPR Session Service or CASI semantic-appearance implementation
